svg.title: A study path that ends in a passed interview
svg.desc: Five phase system design study path: build fundamentals such as latency, throughput, load balancing and caching in weeks one and two, learn data layer topics including replication, sharding and the CAP theorem in weeks three and four, learn the distributed building blocks of queues, CDNs and rate limiting in week five, work through case studies in weeks six and seven, and finish with mock interviews under time pressure in week eight.
